question.zh-CN: 如何用可控实验加速研发，同时识别仿真无法替代的真实因素？
question.en: How can controlled experiments accelerate development while exposing what simulation cannot replace?

problem.zh-CN: 计算运动、碰撞与接触响应。
problem.en: Compute motion, collision and contact responses.

research.zh-CN: 可微物理、摩擦模型与数值稳定。
research.en: Differentiable physics, friction models and numerical stability.

industry.zh-CN: 求解速度、模型标定与资产兼容。
industry.en: Solver speed, model calibration and asset compatibility.

compare.zh-CN: 接触误差、稳定性与仿真吞吐。
compare.en: Contact error, stability and simulation throughput.

problem.zh-CN: 建立场景、机器人与物体的数字表示。
problem.en: Build digital representations of scenes, robots and objects.

research.zh-CN: 重建、参数辨识与自动资产生成。
research.en: Reconstruction, parameter identification and automated asset generation.

industry.zh-CN: 资产质量、版本维护与现场一致性。
industry.en: Asset quality, version maintenance and site consistency.

compare.zh-CN: 几何动力学误差、制作成本与更新时间。
compare.en: Geometry and dynamics error, creation cost and update time.

problem.zh-CN: 生成多模态观测及其标签。

research.zh-CN: 渲染真实性、触觉仿真与数据混合。
research.en: Rendering fidelity, tactile simulation and data mixing.

industry.zh-CN: 生成流程、标注规范与域差评估。
industry.en: Generation workflows, annotation standards and domain-gap assessment.

compare.zh-CN: 传感差异、标签质量与真实任务增益。
compare.en: Sensor gap, label quality and real-task benefit.

problem.zh-CN: 提高策略训练和比较效率。
problem.en: Improve policy training and comparison efficiency.

research.zh-CN: 分布式采样、优化稳定与可复现性。
research.en: Distributed sampling, optimization stability and reproducibility.

industry.zh-CN: 资源调度、检查点、成本与版本固定。
industry.en: Resource scheduling, checkpoints, cost and pinned versions.

compare.zh-CN: 训练预算、随机种子方差与复现实验。
compare.en: Training budget, seed variance and reproducible runs.

problem.zh-CN: 降低仿真与实机行为差异。
problem.en: Reduce behavioral differences between simulation and hardware.

research.zh-CN: 自适应随机化、系统辨识与残差学习。
research.en: Adaptive randomization, identification and residual learning.

industry.zh-CN: 真实校准、迁移测试与故障回退。
industry.en: Real calibration, transfer tests and fallback behavior.

compare.zh-CN: 真实任务成功率与迁移所需数据。
compare.en: Real-task success and data needed for transfer.

problem.zh-CN: 在上线前测试控制与通信链路。
problem.en: Test control and communication chains before release.

research.zh-CN: 联合仿真、时序一致与边界覆盖。
research.en: Co-simulation, temporal consistency and boundary coverage.

industry.zh-CN: 真实控制器接入、故障注入与回归测试。
industry.en: Real controller integration, fault injection and regression tests.

compare.zh-CN: 时序误差、故障覆盖与测试可重复性。
compare.en: Timing error, fault coverage and repeatability.
